description: This file defines the ApiCallMonitoringMiddleware class, which extends AbstractMonitoringMiddleware. It provides methods for wrapping middleware, extracting request and response data, and handling API call attempt events for AWS SDK monitoring.

classes.name: ApiCallMonitoringMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for monitoring AWS SDK API calls, handling event data extraction, retries, and latency measurement.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper with provided credentials, options, region, and service.

methods.name: getRequestData
methods.description: Returns an empty array for request data.

methods.name: getResponseData
methods.description: Extracts attempt count, retries, and final attempt data from the response or exception.

methods.name: getResultAttemptCount
methods.description: Counts HTTP transfer stats from a ResultInterface object.

methods.name: getExceptionAttemptCount
methods.description: Counts ApiCallAttempt events from an exception implementing MonitoringEventsInterface.

methods.name: getFinalAttemptData
methods.description: Retrieves final attempt event data, including specific event keys.

methods.name: getFinalAttempt
methods.description: Finds the last ApiCallAttempt event in an array of events.

methods.name: getMaxRetriesExceeded
methods.description: Checks if the exception indicates max retries exceeded.

methods.name: populateRequestEventData
methods.description: Adds 'ApiCall' type to request event data.

methods.name: populateResultEventData
methods.description: Calculates and adds latency to result event data.
